info.title: Lupira Tasks API
info.description: Task and command processing backend for Lupira. Authenticate with a Bearer token issued by the OIDC provider (Authentik).

get.summary: Authenticated claims echo for dependency probes; resolves nothing, writes nothing.

get.description:
Returns the current list plus all its live items (v1 full re-derive,
regardless of `?since=`) and a `nextCursor` to pass on the next pull. The
client rebases its local mirror onto this base, then re-applies non-acked
outbox rows.

post.summary: Redeem a share link as the authenticated caller (join the list).
post.description: Body `{ token }`. Adds the caller to the linked list — `ReadWrite` → Editor, `Read` → Viewer — and returns `{ listId, role }`. Idempotent: an existing member keeps their current role. Used by the web client to cash in a share link after SSO.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated GUIDv7 command id. A redelivery with the same key is a no-op that returns the prior result (offline-safe retry).

get.summary: Provision and return the caller's profile.
get.description:
Upserts the caller's `UserProfile` from the bearer token (create on first
login, else bump `LastSeenAt` and refresh display name / admin flag) and
returns `{ email, displayName, isAdmin }`. Call on app cold start.

get.summary: People seen across the caller's shared lists (for adding members).
get.description: `?q=` filters the distinct member emails (case-insensitive substring).

get.summary: List the lists the caller is a member of.
get.description: `?archived=true` returns the caller's archived lists instead of the active ones.

post.summary: Create a list; the caller becomes Owner.
post.description: Body `{ id (GUIDv7), name, kind, color? }`. `kind` is `Todo`, `Shopping`, or `Agent` (agent/system-owned lists). Re-sending an existing id is an idempotent success.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

patch.description: Each provided field emits its own event. Set `colorProvided` to apply `color` (incl. clearing it). Send `simplePriority` (bool) to switch between simple on/off and the full 0..9 scale.

post.summary: Set the caller's own position for this list (Viewer+).
post.description: Body `{ sortOrder }` — a fractional-index key generated between the neighbours the list was dropped between. Per-user: other members' ordering is untouched, and this does not count as a change to the list. Returned as `sortOrder` on the caller's `ListDto`; lists the caller has never ordered come back null and sort by name after the ordered ones.

post.summary: Add a member by email (any member; defaults to Editor).
post.description: Body `{ email, role? }`. Direct-add, no invite/accept. An unseen email provisions a placeholder principal (its `sub` is upgraded when the person first logs in). Members are returned with their `principalId`; use that for role change / removal.

get.summary: Search items across the caller's lists (Viewer+).
get.description: Case-insensitive `query` title substring, optional `completed`/`status`. `dueFrom`/`dueTo` bound `dueAt` half-open `[from, to)`; either bound implies `dueAt` is set. Spans every list the caller is a member of (archived included).

patch.summary: Edit item fields addressed by id (Editor+); the list is resolved server-side.
patch.description: Same body as the list-scoped PATCH (`*Provided` flags). 404 if no such item or the caller can't edit its list.

post.summary: Link a task to a cal-api Prompt heartbeat or an external ref (Editor+).
post.description: Body `{ toKind, toRef, relationType, metadata? }`. `toKind` e.g. `cal-item` (the checking heartbeat Prompt) or `url` (issue/PR/incident/release). `relationType` e.g. `monitors`, `spawned-by`, `produced`, `blocked-by`, `relates-to`. Idempotent: re-linking the same edge is a no-op.

delete.summary: Remove a task relation by its edge tuple (Editor+).
delete.description: Identify the edge with `?toKind=&toRef=&relationType=`. Idempotent: removing a link that isn't there is a no-op (204).

post.summary: Mint a public share link for a list (Owner).
post.description: Body `{ access: 'Read' | 'ReadWrite', label?, expiresAt? }`. Returns the opaque token + a ready-to-copy URL. The link grants account-less access at `/shared/{token}` until revoked or expired.

role.description: Role to grant. Defaults to Editor when null.

AddMemberRequest.description:
Add a member to a list by email. Any member may add someone; the role defaults to
ListRole.Editor when omitted. Only a real Authentik user can ever use the
membership (provisioned on first login), so a wrong email is simply inert.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock at the moment of the change (LWW key). Defaults to server now.

CreateItemRequest.description:
Add an item. The client supplies a GUIDv7 Guid CreateItemRequest.Id (idempotent create) and a
fractional-index string CreateItemRequest.SortOrder string. DateTimeOffset? CreateItemRequest.OccurredAt is the
client wall-clock used for last-writer-wins; when omitted the server stamps now.

CreateListRequest.description:
Create a list. The client supplies a GUIDv7 Guid CreateListRequest.Id so the create is
idempotent on replay (an existing stream is treated as success). The caller
becomes the Owner.

CreateShareRequest.description:
Mint a share link for a list. ShareAccess CreateShareRequest.Access picks read vs read/write; an optional
DateTimeOffset? CreateShareRequest.ExpiresAt auto-expires the link; string? CreateShareRequest.Label is a human name used for
attribution of writes (`share:{label}`) and shown in the owner's list of links.

DirectoryPerson.description: A person the caller has seen across their shared lists (for adding members).

DirectoryResponse.description: The distinct people across the caller's lists, for member-add autocomplete.

status.description: The lifecycle status; bool ItemDto.Completed is the derived `Status == Done` convenience.

completedBy.description: Who completed it; `null` if open, or a share-link/unresolved actor.

createdBy.description: Who created it; `null` for a share-link/unresolved actor.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON for agent/server bookkeeping. Server-side only — never in the public share DTO.

ItemDto.description: An item's current snapshot. Clients nest by Guid? ItemDto.ParentItemId.

ItemStatus.description:
An item's lifecycle position — one state machine, not two flags. ItemStatus.Open, ItemStatus.InProgress,
ItemStatus.Blocked, and ItemStatus.Waiting are open; ItemStatus.Done and ItemStatus.Cancelled are
closed. `Completed` is derived (`Status == Done`). The value is LWW-guarded by one
(OccurredAt, CommandId) guard shared by every lifecycle event, so done-ness and the open sub-state can never
disagree. Lets the assistant answer "what's blocked / waiting on me?".

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock at the moment of the change (LWW key). Defaults to server now.

ItemTimestampRequest.description:
Body for complete/reopen/delete. Carries only the LWW timestamp; the item id is in
the route. DateTimeOffset? ItemTimestampRequest.OccurredAt defaults to server now when omitted.

access.description:
The caller's own role on this list — server-authoritative, so clients gate owner/editor
            UI on this instead of matching themselves against IReadOnlyList<MemberDto> ListDto.Members.

sortOrder.description:
The caller's own position for this list (fractional-index key), or null if they have
            never reordered it — clients sort those by name, after the keyed ones. Nobody else's ordering
            is exposed.

archivedAt.description:
When the list was archived; null while active. Archived views sort on this rather than
            DateTimeOffset ListDto.UpdatedAt, which later edits bump.

ListDto.description: Full list metadata including members and tag definitions.

ListKind.description:
Drives client UI affordances (e.g. shopping lists surface quantity/unit), and distinguishes
            agent/system-owned lists from a user's own (ListKind.Agent) in queries and UI. A pure label set at
            creation (carried by `ListCreated`); ownership/membership still govern access.

ListRole.description: A member's authority on a list. Ordered: Owner > Editor > Viewer.

addedBy.description: Who added them; `null` for a share-link add or an unresolved actor.

MemberDto.description: A member of a list: the stable `PrincipalId` plus resolved `Email`/`DisplayName`.

MeResponse.description:
The caller's provisioned identity, returned by `GET /me`. Guid MeResponse.PrincipalId is
            the stable internal id a client stores and matches against list members (and uses as its offline
            actor); email/displayName are for display.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock at the moment of the change (LWW key). Defaults to server now.

MoveItemRequest.description:
Reparent and/or reorder an item. string MoveItemRequest.SortOrder is a fractional-index
string so concurrent inserts get distinct keys without renumbering siblings.

PersonRef.description: The canonical identity projection on the read boundary: the stable Guid PersonRef.PrincipalId (the key a client should store/compare) plus the current string PersonRef.Email and string? PersonRef.DisplayName for display. Every identity slot the API returns (owner, member, assignee, creator, completer, directory person) is a `PersonRef`; identity inputs stay email (invite/assign). Built from a resolved Principal.

PingDto.description:
The claims a caller's token resolved to, echoed for cross-service auth-seam probes.
            Returning the audiences (not a bare 200) lets a failing consumer see which half of the seam
            is misconfigured.

RedeemShareRequest.description: Redeem a share link as the authenticated caller (the token, not in the URL path here).

RedeemShareResponse.description: The list the caller joined and the role they now hold on it.

SetListOrderRequest.description:
Set the caller's own position for a list in their lists screen. string SetListOrderRequest.SortOrder is a
fractional-index string (same scheme as item ordering) generated client-side between the
neighbours it was dropped between. Per-user: other members are unaffected.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock for LWW; defaults to server now when omitted.

SetMetadataRequest.description: Sets an item's free-form JSON metadata (whole-field). Send `null` to clear it.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock for LWW; defaults to server now when omitted.

SetStatusRequest.description: Sets an item's lifecycle status, with an optional reason (e.g. why it's Blocked/Waiting).

ShareAccess.description: What a public share link permits.

SharedItemDto.description:
An item as shown to a share-link recipient. Mirrors the fields a viewer/editor needs but
OMITS every email field (`assignedTo`, `completedBy`, `createdBy`) so a public
link never leaks family emails.

SharedListResponse.description:
The public, account-less view of a shared list. Deliberately TRIMMED: it carries no member
list, no owner email, and items carry no assignee/creator/completer emails — a public link must
not leak family emails. ShareAccess SharedListResponse.Access tells the client whether to show edit controls.

SharedTagDto.description: A tag definition as shown on a shared list (no sensitive data).

ShareDto.description: A share link as the owner sees it, including the opaque string ShareDto.Token and ready-to-copy string ShareDto.Url.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `?since=` on the next pull.

SyncResponse.description:
A full re-derive of a list and its live items, for the offline delta-pull. v1 is
"simplest-correct": the whole list + all non-deleted items are returned regardless of
the `since` cursor, and long SyncResponse.NextCursor is the high-water mark of the items'
update timestamps (the client plumbs the cursor through but the server ignores it for now).

TagDto.description: A tag definition on a list.

priority.description: Priority 0..9 (0 = none). Only applied when bool UpdateItemRequest.PriorityProvided is true.

occurredAt.description: Client wall-clock at the moment of the change (LWW key). Defaults to server now.

UpdateItemRequest.description:
Patch an item. Emits exactly one event per changed field. A field changes only when
its `*Provided` flag is true, so a `null` value can be sent intentionally
(e.g. unassign, clear due date) without being confused with "leave unchanged".
DateTimeOffset? UpdateItemRequest.OccurredAt is the client wall-clock used for per-field LWW.

color.description: The new color. Honored only when bool UpdateListRequest.ColorProvided is true.

colorProvided.description: Set true to apply string? UpdateListRequest.Color (including clearing it to null).

simplePriority.description: Whether priority is a simple on/off (true) or the full 0..9 scale (false). Null leaves it unchanged.

UpdateListRequest.description:
Patch a list's metadata. Each non-null field emits its own event; omit a field
(leave it `null`) to leave it unchanged. To clear the color, send
bool UpdateListRequest.ColorProvided = `true` with string? UpdateListRequest.Color = `null`.

UpdateMemberRoleRequest.description: Change a member's role on a list (Owner only).

Bearer.description: OIDC bearer token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
